'''Baquor''' was a type of fabric. During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Glottalphib]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nandreeson]] kept a baquor-lined [[Couch/Legends|sofa]] inside his base on [[Skip 6]], on the [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]].
